compiler_only_output.reason: mwccarm emits the base-object destructor beside the licensed D1/D0 pair. The cartridge has no D2 for this class -- ov085 runs D1 at 0x02129020 straight into D0 at 0x02129060 and then into _ZN11daKinopio_c12GetMessageIDEv at 0x021290b4, with no third variant in the overlay's delinks partition and no symbol of that name configured in any module -- so there is no configured home and no surviving relocation references it.

Three members declare Vector3 locals (St_Talk_Main's playerPos/messagePos/starPos, Behavior's two copies, InitResources' objPos), so this TU re-emits Vector3's vague-linkage D1 alongside its own text. The cartridge keeps one copy at arm9:0x020072c0, and src/_ZN7Vector3D1Ev.cpp already owns it as a complete .text 0x020072c0..0x020072c4 range; rombuild compares this object's body against those cartridge bytes and refuses anything but byte-identical vague-linkage output before discarding the duplicate.

This TU emits daKinopio_c's class vtable: it is the TU that materializes the class's only virtual destructor and its factory constructs the class, so mwcc emits the complete 0x84-byte storage with its ABI preamble. The cartridge's storage begins at ov085:0x0212feb0, where offset-to-top is 0 and the next word at 0x0212feb4 points at _ZTI11daKinopio_c (0x0212fe50); the public address point recorded in symbols.txt is 0x0212feb8, eight bytes above the start of storage and outside this text-only entry's licensed range, so dsd supplies that ROM data independently. romdata_check applies the measured eight-byte address-point bias and proves every emitted slot and relocation against the cartridge before production isolation discards the copy.
